title: Scenario 10: a render run as a background job with start_render, polled and fetched
prompt:
Using the pscat-render tools, run this PostScript program as a background render job instead of a single call (it takes a few seconds on purpose), wait until it has finished, fetch its result, and tell me what came back:

%!PS
realtime /t0 exch def { realtime t0 sub 3000 gt { exit } if } loop
0 0.6 0 setrgbcolor 0 0 200 100 rectfill
showpage

Use a 200 x 100 point page.
